statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
The diagnosis codes supporting the need for this procedure are R00.2 and R42.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The billed balance for this service is 661.9.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
